preamble.summary: Psalm 90 — 'Lord, you have been our dwelling place in all generations' (Moses' psalm). Marks the opening of Book IV. 11QPsᵃ does not preserve continuous text here.
preamble.notable_variants: No significant content variants. Minor orthographic variation only (the standard Qumran plene-spelling tendency).
preamble.scroll_condition: Fragmentary attestation; no continuous DSS coverage.
